topic.title: DITA Harness User Guide
topic.shortdesc: User guide for viewing, rendering, querying, and chatting with DITA documentation rendered by a React web application with a RAG Vector Search service, and AI Assistant.

section.title: Welcome to the DITA Harness
section.p: The DITA Harness provides an interactive web application for browsing DITA documentation, viewing rich Bootstrap components, querying content via semantic vector search (RAG Service), and chatting with an AI Assistant. Content is published from DITA source files and automatically rendered in modern web browser views.

section.title: Quick Start with Docker Compose
section.p: Launch the complete React Harness documentation system (data-store, renderer, mcp-server, and optional rag-service) using Docker Compose:
Once launched, access the system services in your browser:

ul.li: Documentation Portal: http://localhost:3000 — View and browse loaded documentation sets.
AI Assistant Chat: http://localhost:3000/chat — Chat with the AI documentation assistant.
RAG Vector Search Service: http://localhost:4002/health — Check semantic vector search status.

section.title: Creating Documentation
section.p: Generate a document set's AST content using DITA-OT:

ol.li: Generating AST: Publish your DITA map using the ast-bootstrap format: dita --input=path/to/document.ditamap \ --format=ast-bootstrap See Generating AST for detailed instructions on AST publishing and custom header/footer templates.

Generating Chrome: Generate global chrome layouts for the React web application using the ast-chrome format: dita --input=path/to/document.ditamap \ --format=ast-chrome \ --output=path/to/output See Generating Chrome for overridable chrome elements.

section.title: Viewing, Rendering & Navigation Features
section.p: The web reader offers rich interactive controls for viewing and reading documentation:

plentry.pd: A visual catalog displaying all published document sets. Select any card to open its topic reader view.
A multi-level Table of Contents sidebar for expanding chapters and navigating directly between topics.
DITA elements (tables, accordions, alerts, badges, cards, code blocks, figures) render as live interactive Bootstrap components with column sorting, text filtering, and pagination.

pt.b: RAG Vector Search & Header Search Bar

plentry.pd: Type keywords into the header search bar or chat prompt to query topics. Requests leverage the standalone RAG Service for high-speed semantic vector ranking.
Toggle between Light, Dark, and System Auto color themes via the header menu.
Chat with an AI Assistant to answer questions about the documentation corpus or preview interactive topic components inline.

section.title: User Configuration (.env)
section.p: Environment variables in your .env file select the site theme, the AI Assistant's LLM provider and credentials, and service authorization:

plentry.pd: Site Bootswatch theme (e.g. default, darkly, journal).
Active LLM provider: gemini, anthropic, openai, or ollama.
Local Ollama endpoint, model, and container version.
Streamable HTTP endpoint of mcp-server used by /chat.
Set to true to show debug badges for AI tool calls in chat.
Bearer token guarding data-store's write API. Unset by default.

section.p: See Web Renderer, Search Bar & AI Chat Bot, and Data Store Service for setup details.
